# Digipincode

India's village, pincode and panchayat directory: 6 lakh villages, 1.5 lakh+ pincodes, LGD codes, DIGIPIN and post office details for every place in India.

> Data sources: India Post pincode directory, Census of India, Local Government Directory (LGD), Ministry of Panchayati Raj. Facility data is progressively verified from Census 2011 Village Directory / DCHB records.

## Key pages

- [Home & search](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/): search any pincode, village or panchayat
- [All states](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/states): browse the full state › district › tehsil › village hierarchy
- [Pincode pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/pincode/110001): post office, delivery status, villages and panchayats per pincode
- [Village pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/states): population, LGD/census codes, DIGIPIN, panchayat, post office and facilities
- [Panchayat pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/panchayat/1234567): local body details, block, villages
- [Saved pages](https://digipincode.india-in.workers.dev/saved): user favourites (client-side only)

## Site structure

/state/{state} — all districts of a state
/state/{state}/{district} — sub-districts, village stats, largest villages
/state/{state}/{district}/{tehsil} — all villages with pincodes
/village/{slug} — individual village profile
/pincode/{6-digit-pincode} — post office and area details
/panchayat/{lgd-code} — panchayat administration details

## Notes

- Facility fields on village pages show collection status until verified Census 2011 values are imported — no invented data.
- User corrections welcome via the Report an Issue button on every page.
